description: Wind Turbine Permissions is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cornwall Council. This data set has been derived from the Development Management system used by Cornwall Council's Planning and Regeneration Service. It should be noted that the data included does not necessarilly mean that a wind turbine exists on the site shown, merely that planning permission has been granted for the development. Coverage: Cornwall Council. The portal files it under the publisher Cornwall Council. Its tags are renewable_energy_source, wind_power. The portal shows 2020-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
